description: Source code implementing sparse matrix operations (e.g., sparse-dense matrix multiplication, addition, and solving) for PyTorch, with support for MKL, Eigen, and Triton kernels, specifically for CSR and BSR sparse formats.

methods.name: operands_support_triton_mm_kernel
methods.description: Checks if the operands support Triton matrix multiplication kernel based on layout, data type, block size, and size divisibility.

methods.name: _compressed_row_strided_mm_out
methods.description: Performs sparse-dense matrix multiplication for CSR or BSR formats with output stored in 'result'.

methods.name: _compressed_row_strided_addmm_out
methods.description: Performs sparse matrix multiplication and adds to 'result', supporting optional scaling by alpha and beta.

methods.name: addmv_out_sparse_csr
methods.description: Computes sparse matrix-vector product for CSR or BSR matrices, with support for different data types and layouts.

methods.name: add_out_sparse_csr
methods.description: Adds two sparse matrices (CSR format), with support for MKL and Eigen backends.

methods.name: triangular_solve_out_sparse_csr
methods.description: Solves a triangular system with a sparse CSR or BSR matrix, requires MKL support.
